svg.text: 8-Bit 5-Stage Pipelined RISC Microprocessor - Datapath, Control and Hazard Schematic
Every block, port and wire is named exactly as in rtl/cpu_core.sv (cpu_top = cpu_core + instruction_mem + data_mem)
Wires that cross WITHOUT a dot are not connected. Small arrows with a name = signal passed by name.
EX/MEM forward bus: fwd_val_mem = is_jal ? pc+1 : alu_result (FWD_MEM, 1 instr ahead)
wb_data -> RegFile.wr_data and FWD MUX (FWD_WB, 2 instr ahead)
jump_target (imm, or rs1 for JR) -> PC MUX [JMP / JAL / JR]
IF/ID (ID stage): cu_rs1, cu_rs2, uses_rs1, uses_rs2
fwd_a[1:0], fwd_b[1:0] -> FWD MUX A / B (EX)
stall -> PC MUX / PC hold, IF/ID register
Notes: clk and rst_n go to every register (PC, 4 pipeline registers, register file, data memory). R0 is hardwired to 0 (reads 0, writes ignored).
pc fields exist inside IF/ID and ID/EX structs for debug but are not used downstream. halted latches when HALT reaches WB (valid & is_halt) and freezes the PC.
Branches and jumps resolve in EX: taken -> 2-cycle flush. Load-use -> 1 stall bubble. Register-to-register RAW dependencies -> forwarding, 0 stalls.
Memory model: Harvard. Instruction memory is read combinationally by pc; data memory writes on the clock edge and reads combinationally.
